(10) A black screen appears with white Chinese text centered in the frame. (11) The woman is now in a large city square, talking animatedly to a man in a white shirt and sunglasses. They are surrounded by heavy traffic and many pedestrians crossing the street. (12) A close-up of the woman's face shows her reacting with fear and excitement as a large red truck with green crates passes very close to her. Her eyes are wide and her mouth is open. (13) The camera captures a montage of the pair attempting to cross the street. They stay close to local pedestrians for safety. A blue car and several trucks squeeze through the narrow gaps between people. (14) A final sequence shows a woman in a black headscarf sitting in a wheelchair being pushed by a young boy across a busy road. Her leg is in a complex metal external fixator device. The traffic noise is very dense with engine rumbles. (2) A sharp transition occurs as the BGM continues. A female voice reacts with a sharp 'Wow' to the sight of an old car. Frequent short honks of varying pitch punctuate the soundscape, creating a chaotic urban texture. (3) The female voice expresses concern for a child on a motorcycle. The engine of the motorcycle creates a distinct mid-frequency buzz. The BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic beat under the dialogue. (4) An exaggerated vocal SFX 'Ai-yo-wei' from the female host marks a shift in tone to comedic surprise. The sound of wind rushing past a car window is briefly audible. (5) A loud, sustained truck horn occurs, masking the BGM briefly. The female voice shrieks in mock terror. The male voice responds with a calm, lower-pitched observation about comparing the traffic to Vietnam. (6) The BGM enters a breakdown phase with less percussion. The female host narrates the scene of a woman in a wheelchair. The background is filled with the cacophony of a busy square, with overlapping voices and continuous honking. The audio concludes with a clear spoken CTA.
